title: Elucidating the conformational dynamics of the mitochondrial localization signal, M3, of TDP-43 and accessing potential inhibitors using molecular docking and simulation
authors: Balaji R; Joshi H; Patel BK
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟研究TDP-43线粒体定位信号M3区域与小分子抑制剂的结合，虽涉及蛋白-RNA/DNA结合蛋白的构象动态，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Aberrant mitochondrial localization of the RNA/DNA-binding protein TDP-43 is implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which may affect mitochondrial dynamics and contribute to neuronal toxicity. Inhibitors of the cytoplasmic aggregation of TDP-43 were reported previously, but their effect on the mitochondrial mis-localization of TDP-43 and the mitochondrial function remains to be investigated. Three internal peptide sequences from TDP-43, M1, M3, and M5, were found to enable TDP-43’s mitochondrial localization and competitive inhibition using these peptides thwarted mitochondrial import of TDP-43 and rescued TDP-43-induced cytotoxicity to neurons. Here, we performed a virtual in silico screening of 2,115 FDA-approved small molecules for affinity against the M3 region of TDP-43 (aa: 146 – 150) that lies in the RNA recognition motif-1 (RRM1) domain. Multiple all-atom MD simulations were carried out starting with two different conformations of the tandem RRMs to understand the dynamics of the target M3 region in explicit solvent water. The analysis of the simulation trajectories suggests that the M3 region is relatively non-flexible and buried relative to the other regions of the tandem RRM1-2 domains. Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), from virtual screening, docked consistently with the M3 region in different docking strategies even amidst the region’s poor solvent accessibility. Vitamin D3 also remained stably bound to the M3 region in most frames of four replica MD simulations, each of one microsecond. Taken together, our study proposes vitamin D3 as a potential binder to the M3 region which may inhibit the pathogenic mitochondrial mis-localization of TDP-43.
abstract_zh: RNA/DNA结合蛋白TDP-43的异常线粒体定位与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, ALS）相关，可能影响线粒体动力学并导致神经元毒性。此前已有报道称存在抑制TDP-43细胞质聚集的抑制剂，但其对TDP-43线粒体错误定位及线粒体功能的影响仍有待研究。发现TDP-43的三个内部肽段序列M1、M3和M5能够促进TDP-43的线粒体定位，而使用这些肽段进行竞争性抑制可阻止TDP-43的线粒体输入，并挽救TDP-43诱导的神经元细胞毒性。在此，我们对2,115种FDA批准的小分子进行了虚拟筛选（in silico screening），以评估其与TDP-43 M3区域（氨基酸146–150）的亲和力，该区域位于RNA识别基序-1（RNA recognition motif-1, RRM1）结构域内。我们进行了多次全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，起始于串联RRM的两种不同构象，以理解目标M3区域在显式溶剂水中的动态行为。模拟轨迹分析表明，与串联RRM1-2结构域的其他区域相比，M3区域相对不灵活且埋藏较深。虚拟筛选中的胆钙化醇（维生素D3）在不同对接策略下均与M3区域一致结合，尽管该区域的溶剂可及性较差。在四次重复MD模拟（每次持续一微秒）的大多数帧中，维生素D3也稳定结合于M3区域。综合来看，我们的研究提出维生素D3作为M3区域的潜在结合剂，可能抑制TDP-43的致病性线粒体错误定位。
